---
name: implementation-planning
description: Convert approved requirements and reviewed architecture into a dependency-ordered, verifiable implementation plan.
---

# Implementation Planning Skill
- Inspect current repository structure and build/test conventions.
- Decompose work into small tasks with IDs, dependencies, affected files/components, requirement traceability, and verification steps.
- Identify blocked tasks and parallel work only where safe.
- Include negative/security/boundary tests and regression checks.
- Add human approval gates before implementation and PR creation.
- Do not plan implementation choices that depend on unresolved business rules.
